sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Add the required per-applicable-frame compliance model: identify the canonical relationship linking each structural member to its load case and constrain combinedShearAndBendingDemand to be less than or equal to that member's plasticStrength, with complete quantity/unit handling. Do not merely require plastic-strength evidence. Model the bottom-only patch-load condition through the supplied loadPatchOrientation relation and loadPatchHeightParallelToFrame controlled value, rather than patch-load presence alone. Add a canonical selector for transverse local frames in side structures (and use it so side applicability does not include non-transverse frames); locate the absent canonical relationship/selector terms with the vocabulary matcher.
